summary: R22正式安装含P129/P128/R21：按精确设备持久暂停已知配对失败，普通临时断连仍可重连；真实正常BLE连接一次成功，正确UID/413/UI76、原51会议与429.98秒原音完整、用户自动连接选择不变。
limitations: 首次意外断链/失配发起者仍未确定；本轮没有制造失配，暂停持久化/恢复边界为受影响软件验证，不能当无干预断连恢复通过。OTA严格安装断电route3、2h、会议内容/分人、实测功耗和100KiB/s仍OPEN，提速等Nordic。
changes: Recognize native pairing category through the two existing product context wrappers; ordinary offline errors remain retryable.
Persist pairingRequired only against the exact remembered native address; keep autoReconnectEnabled and manualDisconnect independent.
Pause ordinary background/follower retry and show an explicit actionable connection state; a Type restart does not resume failed automatic pairing.
Explicit normal Connect or explicit auto-connect enable may retry; protected exact-original recovery may resolve pairing without reversing manual opt-out.
CLI --device-connect-request uses the normal coordinator Connect without OOBE/module checks, replacement recording or cloud processing.

provenance.firmware: Current413/normalBoot413/UI76 retained; no MCU write, reset or SWD in this stage.
provenance.original51: Unchanged normal-library row and same WAV SHA; no re-record/ASR. Existing successful recovery is not reclassified as normal unattended reconnect.

subsequentSystemEvent.meaning: Device association enumerator failure AFTER initial loss, at first failed reconnect.

initialLoss.boundary: Service process context is not proof of original requesting application or policy. Existing HCI capture lacks caller/API stacks; no attribution to hardware, user unpairing or OS policy.

validation.scope: No full-suite, fresh recording, OOBE, ASR, speed, WPR or physical power-cut test.
validation.stlinkReason: Original temporary installation-cut window had already been removed by the delivered normal Boot; no redundant rewrite.

retainedBuildFailures: Initial shared-tree compile overlapped unfrozen P129 cancel_reusable edit; all five errors were in that pet file. Frozen P129/R22 source built successfully; no pet WIP overwritten.
First private Rust test lacked generated frontendDist. Generated frontend in same frozen tree, resumed exact source, preserved original failure log.

First install launcher used Windows PowerShell lacking Get-FileHash under this environment and stopped before installation/device access. Verified bundled pwsh supports it; same candidate installed normally.
next: Continue same-trace initial loss attribution only with a new observable hypothesis; do not repeat pairing/reset attempts.
Keep pending strict installation-cut test for a concrete physical Owner slot; ordinary OTA and cold-start proofs remain distinct.
Continue recorder quality, low-battery/full-storage recovery and actual low-power gaps; no new cloud/mobile/dock or speed tuning.
